title: Yesu Ma Ni Malo
author: Jesus High In Glory
stanzas: Yesu ma ni malo winj alamwa ka, Ka wakulore nyimi, Ka wapakoi.
Kata In Ruodh polo, Ng`a maler chutho, To imor kiwinjo Wende nyithindi.
Podi wan nyithindo, Waonge teko Yesu, wuothi kodwa, Kwaluwo yori.
Igeng`wa e temruok, Iritwa pile; Ket hera e chunywa, Golnwa kethrukwa.
Chieng` Yesu koluongowa Wanayie gi mor; "Ee, Ruodhwa wabiro, Wanadhi kodi."
